about.title: About
about.intro1: I work in Sports Data in football, focused on youth academy categories. Part of my day is operational and analytical — processing GPS data, building load & wellness dashboards, generating per-athlete reports. The other part is building and improving the systems that do it: pipelines, local databases, internal tools.
about.intro2: I'm consolidating data engineering fundamentals through these projects — each one is on this site as evidence of what I already build in practice, not of a title I don't hold yet.
about.intro3: Outside work, I love learning and building with AI agents — Cursor and Claude Code are part of my daily workflow — and I build personal tools powered by locally-run AI with mandatory human-in-the-loop approval, like a Telegram agenda bot.
about.domain1: GPS and training load (session metrics, week-over-week, targets)
about.domain2: Wellness: Hooper Index, post-training RPE, adherence
about.domain4: Pipelines: raw files → local database → cloud (always upsert)

projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: Five real systems — three from the football domain (demos use fictional data only) and two personal. Each with a full case study and an interactive demo.

gps-load-dashboard.title: GPS & Load Dashboard
gps-load-dashboard.description: Full-stack GPS, wellness and strength platform for youth academy categories: local-first pipeline, Next.js + FastAPI + SQLite, upsert sync to the cloud and client-side PDF.

performance-hub.title: Multi-department Performance Hub
performance-hub.description: Multi-department dashboard in production (Streamlit + SQLite): physiology, medicine and multidisciplinary areas in one app, with self-service imports and per-athlete PDF.

evaluations-hub.title: Academy Evaluations Hub
evaluations-hub.description: Evaluations and attendance hub (Next.js + Supabase): per-department calendar, weekly compliance and read-only GPS data through a shared database.

local-ai-agent.title: Local AI Agent (Human-in-the-Loop)
local-ai-agent.description: Desktop agent (Tauri + Rust) with a local LLM via Ollama: the model only proposes actions; everything goes through an approval queue with diffs, file sandboxing and an audit log.

personal-ops.title: Personal Ops + Telegram Bot
personal-ops.description: Personal agenda (Flask + JSON, no build step) with a Telegram conversation bot on a local LLM — mandatory confirmation before writes and anti-hallucination enforced in code.
